title: Quantum-to-Macro Translator — Overview and definition

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Models how quantum-scale behavior propagates to measurable macro properties. (Proposed capability.) A quantum-to-macro translator would chain ab initio, MD, and continuum models to predict how nanoscale changes shift engineering properties. Narrow chains are demonstrated (catalysis, transport); general translation is simulated. Status: simulated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
